correctness.rationale: Direct exhaustive 21,497-face computation; 10,723 acyclic pairs globally verified against 107,288 covers; 1/12/37 critical cells; exact 12x37 Morse boundary with two annihilating rows and a determinant-minus-one ten-by-ten minor proving ten unit Smith factors. value.rationale: An exact integral mixed-dimensional homotopy classification of the natural smallest four-row square cylinder, illuminating how periodic boundary closure changes two homotopy-degree multiplicities from those of the open rectangular four-by-four grid. Its explicit primitive integral attaching map is reproducible and has value as a benchmark even without a general width formula.
